entities.summary: Innvik Church is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Stryn Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. It is located in the village of Innvik. It is the church for the Innvik parish which is part of the Nordfjord prosti (deanery) in the Diocese of Bjørgvin. The white, wooden church was built in an octagonal design in 1822 using plans drawn up by the architect Elling Olsen Waldboe. The church seats about 350 people.
